overview: This is a fixed starter sprint, so you can see how it works before deciding on more. You send us your updates: new text, images, posts, pages or offers. We make them in your Framer project, fix anything broken, check links and forms and review each page on phone and desktop. You get a short report of what changed and ideas for next steps. Ongoing monthly care is quoted separately.

faq: No. This is a single sprint with a fixed scope. If you want us to handle updates each month, we quote a monthly plan separately after seeing how often your site changes.
How do I send you the updates?
Share a document or sheet with the new text, and a folder of images. Tell us where each item goes. If anything is unclear, we ask before we change your live pages.
Do you edit my live site directly?
We make edits in a duplicate and publish once you approve, unless you prefer us to publish straight away for small text fixes. You choose when you order.
Can you write the new text for me?
This sprint is for placing content you provide. If you want us to write it, ask for our copy add-on or a quote, so the scope and cost are clear.
